vol.name: Speed Racer: Tales from the Road - Frankenstein's Dragster

title: Speed Racer: Tales from the Road - Frankenstein's Dragster #1
desc: Speed Racer: Tales from the Road is an all-new quarterly release featuring a one-shot tale and backup shorts that expand the universe of Speed Racer! In this issue's spine-chilling feature, a ghastly scavenger feeding on wrecked racers haunts the streets...until its car-nnibalistic feeding frenzy puts it on a collision course with Speed Racer AND Racer X! Don't miss the debut of a BRAND NEW RACER in this story by Eisner-winner Chris Robinson (Werewolf Frankenstein) and celebrated artist Guillermo Sanna! Plus: short stories from writers Brandon Thomas (Excellence, Horizon) and Zoe Tunnell (Blade Maidens, Godzilla Valentine’s Day Special) featuring Trixie Turnwell and more!
